description.short_caption: Grouped vesicles and erosions on the buttock and upper thigh.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a cluster of vesicles and erosions on the buttock and upper thigh. The lesions are grouped and appear to follow a linear or dermatomal distribution. The surrounding skin shows mild erythema, and some vesicles appear to have ruptured, forming crusts. The pattern and appearance suggest a vesicular dermatosis, potentially infectious in origin.
